question: Does the portable package meet the criteria for source distribution and personal installation?

sources.applicability: Source for attachment drift, distinct confirmed attempts, and receipt and byte limits. No private material or performance evidence included.
Adjacent drafting and later reconciliation boundaries.
Independent role review and bounded release.
Visible to authors and reviewers. Analytical design checks.

acceptance_criteria: Exact applicant, requisition and attempt binding
Separate verified selection, stored bytes, submission and time claims
No unauthorized action, disclosure, duplicate retry, or loss of existing evidence
Portable supplied-evidence mode with adjacent workflow routing
Release claims limited to recorded evidence

claims.basis: S1, SE-02, SE-05, SE-08 and SE-09
claims.consequence: Wrong applicant, role, file or attempt can be certified.
A receipt can be mistaken for a byte match or exact submission time.

claims.basis: SE-04, SE-06 and SE-08 through SE-13
claims.consequence: Unauthorized disclosure, duplicate action or lost evidence.
A bare receipt prompt can match either skill. Automatic activation is untested.

claims.basis: S3, S4 and verified SHA-256 manifest
claims.consequence: A design review can be mistaken for performance evidence.

roles.result: Conditional pass after applicant, attempt, selection, timestamp and routing revisions.
Conditional pass. Supplied evidence supports the requested handoff. Bare receipt intent needs clarification.
Conditional pass after minimum-disclosure, guarded-write and delayed-completion rules.
Receipt-plus-snapshot partial completion defect reproduced analytically and closed by SE-13 recheck.
Approve with limits based on separate evidence claims and item-scoped readback and replay.

limitations: Shared model family and frozen source set
No live portal, connector or matched execution

follow_up.next_test: Use a matched with-skill and without-skill run with an unseen holdout. Test ambiguous receipt activation with both skills installed.
follow_up.review_expiry: Reopen when authority, receipt identity, write behavior or target-host activation changes.

personal_host_adapter.scope: Personal installation only. Portable GitHub source contains the same core and review files.
